# ToolkitLife — Free Online Tools & Calculators

> ToolkitLife is a collection of 372 free, browser-based tools and calculators. No signup required. No data stored. All processing happens locally in the user's browser.

## Tools

### Marketing Tools
- [What Is My Browser](https://toolkitlife.com/tools/what-is-my-browser): Detect your browser, OS and IP address.
- [GEO IP Locator](https://toolkitlife.com/tools/geo-ip-locator): Find the geographic location of any IP address.
- [Redirect Checker](https://toolkitlife.com/tools/redirect-checker): Check URL redirects and final destination.
- [Is It Down](https://toolkitlife.com/tools/is-it-down): Check if a website is down or reachable.
- [Domain Age Checker](https://toolkitlife.com/tools/domain-age): Find out how old any domain is.
- [Domain Hosting Checker](https://toolkitlife.com/tools/domain-hosting): Find out where any domain is hosted.
- [XML Sitemap Generator](https://toolkitlife.com/tools/xml-sitemap): Generate an XML sitemap for your website instantly.
- [Adsense Calculator](https://toolkitlife.com/tools/adsense-calculator): Estimate your Google AdSense earnings.
- [URL Opener](https://toolkitlife.com/tools/url-opener): Open multiple URLs at once in new tabs.
- [Mobile Friendly Test](https://toolkitlife.com/tools/mobile-friendly-test): Check if your website is mobile-friendly.
- [Keyword Density Checker](https://toolkitlife.com/tools/keyword-density): Analyze keyword frequency and density in your content.
- [Meta Tags Analyzer](https://toolkitlife.com/tools/meta-tags-analyzer): Analyze existing meta tags of any URL.
- [Long Tail Keyword Tool](https://toolkitlife.com/tools/long-tail-keywords): Generate long-tail keyword suggestions for your topic.
- [Keyword Position Checker](https://toolkitlife.com/tools/keyword-position): Check where your keywords rank in search engines.
- [ChatGPT Ads Calculator](https://toolkitlife.com/tools/chatgpt-ads-calculator): Estimate your ChatGPT ad performance and compare ROI against Google, Meta, and TikTok. See impressions, clicks, conversions, and ROAS side-by-side.

- [Unix Timestamp Converter](https://toolkitlife.com/tools/timestamp-converter): Convert Unix timestamps to dates and vice versa. Live current timestamp display.

- [HTML Entity Encoder](https://toolkitlife.com/tools/html-entity-encoder): Encode and decode HTML entities. Convert special characters to HTML entities and back.
- [Chmod Calculator](https://toolkitlife.com/tools/chmod-calculator): Calculate Unix file permissions visually. Convert between octal and symbolic notation.
- [Meta Tag Generator](https://toolkitlife.com/tools/meta-tag-generator): Generate SEO meta tags, Open Graph, and Twitter Cards. Preview Google and social appearance.
- [Robots.txt Generator](https://toolkitlife.com/tools/robots-txt-generator): Generate robots.txt files. Control search engine and AI bot access with a visual builder.
- [Neumorphism Generator](https://toolkitlife.com/tools/neumorphism-generator): Create soft UI / neumorphic CSS effects. Flat, concave, convex, and pressed shapes.
- [JSON to CSV Converter](https://toolkitlife.com/tools/json-to-csv): Convert between JSON and CSV formats. Bidirectional with download support.
- [CSS Text Shadow Generator](https://toolkitlife.com/tools/css-text-shadow): Create CSS text-shadow effects. Multiple layers, neon glow, 3D, fire presets.
- [CSS Flexbox Generator](https://toolkitlife.com/tools/css-flexbox): Build CSS Flexbox layouts visually. Direction, alignment, wrapping, gap with live preview.
- [CSS Grid Generator](https://toolkitlife.com/tools/css-grid): Build CSS Grid layouts visually. Customize columns, rows, gaps, and alignment.
- [URL Slug Generator](https://toolkitlife.com/tools/url-slug-generator): Convert text to URL-friendly slugs. Handles accented characters, bulk conversion.
- [Open Graph Preview](https://toolkitlife.com/tools/og-preview): Preview how your page looks on Google, Facebook, Twitter, Slack, and Discord.
- [CSS Border Radius Generator](https://toolkitlife.com/tools/css-border-radius): Create fancy shapes with 8-value border-radius. Organic blobs, leaves, and asymmetric corners.
- [HTML Table Generator](https://toolkitlife.com/tools/html-table-generator): Create tables with a spreadsheet editor. Export as HTML, Markdown, or CSV.
- [CSS Cubic Bezier Generator](https://toolkitlife.com/tools/css-cubic-bezier): Create custom animation easing curves. Drag control points, preview animations.
- [CSS Background Pattern](https://toolkitlife.com/tools/css-background-pattern): Generate pure CSS background patterns — dots, grids, stripes, checkerboards, and more.
- [JSON Validator](https://toolkitlife.com/tools/json-validator): Validate JSON syntax with error messages and line numbers. Prettify and minify.
- [Binary Converter](https://toolkitlife.com/tools/binary-converter): Convert between decimal, binary, octal, and hexadecimal instantly.
- [Whois Lookup](https://toolkitlife.com/tools/whois-lookup): Check a domain's registrar, registration and expiry dates, and DNS servers in real time via RDAP.
- [IP Address Lookup](https://toolkitlife.com/tools/ip-lookup): Find the owner, CIDR block and country of any IP address, and detect your own public IP.
- [CSS Transform Generator](https://toolkitlife.com/tools/css-transform-generator): Build CSS transforms visually. Translate, rotate, scale, and skew.
- [Base64 to Image](https://toolkitlife.com/tools/base64-to-image): Convert Base64 strings into images with instant preview and download. Free and private.

## Privacy
All tools run entirely in the browser using JavaScript and WebAssembly. No files, text, images, or videos are ever uploaded to a server. No user data is collected or stored.

Website: https://toolkitlife.com
